patch_description: Replace the current 26-parameter ansatz (score 0.66) with a single-shared-parameter design inspired by the best-performing seed (score 0.80, n_params=8). The key insight from prior experiments is that parameter economy dominates the score: collapsing all rotation angles into one shared trainable scalar "theta" achieves perfect train/val/test accuracy while using far fewer parameters. I further densify the fixed (zero-parameter) entangling backbone by adding nearest-neighbor CZ ring + antipodal CZ "diameter" edges + skip-2 CZ edges, raising qubit connectivity degree from 2 to 4 at no parameter cost. This follows the recommendation to append skip-2 CZ links after the nearest-neighbor/antipodal motif, aiming to boost expressivity/generalization and potentially speed convergence while keeping parameter count minimal (single shared scalar "theta" reused across RX, RY, RZ and a CRZ layer).
